item: Recitals 54 and 55: self-evolving behaviour / ML safety functions and third party assessment
what_the_source_says: Recital 54: systems with self-evolving behaviour ensuring safety functions should be in Annex I and get third party assessment, whether placed on the market separately or embedded.
